name: It assumed something that is not true of my setup
about: The skill or tooling assumed a stack, a workflow, or a scale you do not have
title: "[fit] "
labels: fit
---

**This tooling grew out of one person's workspace**, and the parts that are secretly local
rather than universal are invisible from inside it. You can see them and we cannot.

Examples of what belongs here: it assumed a vendor you do not use, a directory layout you do
not have, a scale much larger or smaller than yours, that a human is watching, that work is
code, that a machine is a laptop rather than a server.
